title: Calibrate one optical fixture before multiplying the matrix

rubric.text: First establish one representative case using the current live delegate after recreation and observe the split while pressed; gate expansion on this calibrated case, without requiring a separate review stage.
Use a sensitive edge-region measurement and separate assertions for independent channels; reject whole-member dilution and combined scores that let one channel mask another.

Demonstrate a pass on intended behavior and failure for the suppressed-channel fault, then restore the candidate. Repair an insensitive fixture before replication; do not loosen thresholds to accept the fault.

After calibration expand to all accepted channels, pressed/released states and platforms; preserve meaningful fault sensitivity, same-owner repairs and final validation/review. Do not reduce acceptance to the calibrated case or modify Haze.
